From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Tanzanian long-distance runner

**Restituta Joseph Kemi** (born 30 July 1971 in [Singida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singida_Region "Singida Region")) is a Tanzanian [long-distance runner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long-distance_runner "Long-distance runner"). She twice [carried the flag for Tanzania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_flag_bearers_for_Tanzania_at_the_Olympics "List of flag bearers for Tanzania at the Olympics") at the opening ceremony of the [Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Summer_Olympics "Summer Olympics"): in 2000 and 2004.

She was the 1997 and 1999 winner of the [Corrida de Langueux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrida_de_Langueux "Corrida de Langueux") race.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Tanzanian long-distance runner

**Restituta Joseph Kemi** (born 30 July 1971 in [Singida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singida_Region "Singida Region")) is a Tanzanian [long-distance runner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long-distance_runner "Long-distance runner"). She twice [carried the flag for Tanzania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_flag_bearers_for_Tanzania_at_the_Olympics "List of flag bearers for Tanzania at the Olympics") at the opening ceremony of the [Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Summer_Olympics "Summer Olympics"): in 2000 and 2004.

She was the 1997 and 1999 winner of the [Corrida de Langueux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrida_de_Langueux "Corrida de Langueux") race.

Tanzanian long-distance runner

**Restituta Joseph Kemi** (born 30 July 1971 in [Singida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singida_Region "Singida Region")) is a Tanzanian [long-distance runner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long-distance_runner "Long-distance runner"). She twice carried the flag for Tanzania at the opening ceremony of the [Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Summer_Olympics "Summer Olympics"): in 2000 and 2004.

She was the 1997 and 1999 winner of the [Corrida de Langueux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrida_de_Langueux "Corrida de Langueux") race.

Tanzanian long-distance runner

**Restituta Joseph Kemi** (born 30 July 1971 in [Singida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singida_Region "Singida Region")) is a Tanzanian [long-distance runner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long-distance_runner "Long-distance runner"). She twice carried the flag for Tanzania at the opening ceremony of the [Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Summer_Olympics "Summer Olympics"): in 2000 and 2004.

She was the 1997 and 1999 winner of the [Corrida de Langueux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrida_de_Langueux "Corrida de Langueux") race.
